title: 3D/XR DEVELOPPER
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for: 

  • Design and develop real-time 3D and XR applications and core components
  • Build and optimize XR experiences for visionOS and OpenXR-compliant platforms
  • Implement and maintain rendering pipelines with strict performance and latency constraints
  • Work with spatial tracking, world mapping, hand tracking, and device sensors
  • Optimize frame rate, memory usage, and power consumption on XR devices
  • Integrate 3D engines, native SDKs, and platform-specific APIs
  • Debug complex issues related to rendering, synchronization, and spatial alignment
  • Collaborate with designers, product teams, and systems engineers
  • Participate in architectural decisions and long-term XR technical strategy
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation and review code at a senior level

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong background in real-time 3D mathematics (linear algebra, transforms, projections)
  • Solid experience developing Augmented Reality / XR applications
  • Strong knowledge of visionOS and its spatial computing paradigms
  • Practical experience with OpenXR (runtime integration, extensions, cross-device abstraction)
  • Deep understanding of rendering concepts (render loops, shaders, GPU/CPU synchronization)
  • Experience working under real-time constraints (frame budgets, latency, motion-to-photon)
  • Programming languages : C++ / Swift / Objective-C (for visionOS and Apple platforms) / C# (Unity or engine-level tooling) / Rust (for performance-critical or engine-level components, a strong plus)
  • Frameworks : visionOS SDK, OpenXR, Unity, Unreal Engine, or custom in-house engines, Metal, Vulkan, or DirectX, AR frameworks (ARKit or equivalent spatial tracking systems)

You

  • 5 to 10 years of professional experience in software development, with a significant focus on 3DXR systems programming
  • Proven track record working on technically complex and critical systems
  • Strong 3DXR reasoning and ability to understand large, existing codebases
  • High level of rigor, autonomy, and attention to detail, Strong interest in solving non-trivial technical problems
  • Nice-to-Have Skills : Experience with mixed reality or spatial UI design
  • Nice-To-Have Skills : Contributions to open-source 3D, XR, or graphics-related projects

Interview Process

  1. 15-Min Screening Call â€” Quick chat about motivation, fit and answer your non tech questions.
  2. 2x1-Hour Technical/Product Interview â€” Deeper dive into your problem-solving approach with our CTO and/or our lead solution architect
  3. Team Meet & Greet â€” Informal session to ensure good culture fit.

What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge XR and spatial computing technologies
  • Ownership over technically challenging, real-time systems
  • Highly technical and intellectually challenging projects
  • An environment that values genuine engineering expertise and that is tech focused (no nonsense meetings or reportings)
  • Strong autonomy in technical decision-making
